_comment: Quest 1 TALK path start. post_tutorial shape (warrior L1) standing next to Olesm at the Guild frontage -- cell (29,4) facing UP so the first interact opens olesm_intro (Olesm at 29,3). The TALK path resolves the quest by persuading Watch Captain Zevara (gate, 2,6) to sweep the nest -- NO combat anywhere in the run (its whole point). heard_about_cisterns is NOT banked and the quest NOT started; the script proves give (Olesm) -> persuade (Zevara) -> report (Olesm) -> completion. No rng consumer, so rng_state is cosmetic; kept 9 for convention. TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=9, captured .state), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. This fixture's own canonical never resolves a fight to completion off this rng_state, so its exact value is cosmetic/inert for outcome purposes. Issue #50: [Diplomat] L1 already held (a class the player earns elsewhere, per riverfarm_talk_start's own precedent) so Zevara's sweep_argue mediation shows visible-unlocked -- this fixture is not a COMBAT_BAND_FIXTURE / GATE_FIXTURE so the added class carries no coherence-check cost.
